picks.title: INTEGRATED THERMIONIC DIODE AND MOLTEN OXIDE ELECTROLYSIS CELL
picks.plain_summary: A combined device that extracts oxygen and metals from lunar regolith using heat and electricity.
picks.why_it_matters: In-situ resource extraction is the foundation for permanent lunar bases and deep-space missions — turning Moon dirt into fuel and building materials.

picks.title: LASER MATERIAL FUSION UNDER VACUUM, AND ASSOCIATED SYSTEMS AND METHODS
picks.plain_summary: A method for welding and fusing materials in the vacuum of space to build structures in orbit.
picks.why_it_matters: In-space manufacturing unlocks the ability to assemble large structures where they're needed instead of launching them fully built from Earth.

picks.title: LOW EARTH ORBIT WITH ELECTRIC PROPULSION
picks.plain_summary: Electric thrusters that let spacecraft maneuver efficiently in low Earth orbit for extended periods.
picks.why_it_matters: Orbital agility enables debris removal, satellite servicing, and station-keeping for constellations — the practical backbone of a working space economy.

picks.title: FUEL BUNDLE WITH TWISTED RIBBON FUEL RODLETS FOR NUCLEAR THERMAL PROPULSION APPLICATIONS, STRUCTURES FOR MANUFACTURE, AND METHODS OF MANUFACTURE
picks.plain_summary: A nuclear reactor fuel design optimized for rapid heating and thrust in a nuclear thermal rocket.
picks.why_it_matters: Nuclear thermal propulsion gets crews to Mars in half the time of chemical rockets — the defining propulsion tech for human deep-space exploration.

picks.title: GPU-ACCELERATED DIGITAL TWIN SYSTEM FOR REAL-TIME THERMAL-HYDRAULIC SIMULATION AND CONTROL OF SPACE NUCLEAR REACTORS
picks.plain_summary: AI-powered simulation tools that let engineers monitor and control nuclear reactors powering spacecraft in real time.
picks.why_it_matters: Reliable nuclear propulsion and power systems require predictive control — this is the safety-critical backbone enabling nuclear-powered deep-space missions.

picks.title: SATELLITE CONSTELLATION FORMING SYSTEM
picks.plain_summary: Automated coordination system that keeps multiple satellites in formation to act as a single distributed antenna or sensor array.
picks.why_it_matters: Satellite constellations are the near-term space infrastructure layer — coordinated swarms multiply what each satellite can do alone.

picks.title: Solar Sail for Orbital Maneuvers
picks.plain_summary: Thin reflective sails that use sunlight to push spacecraft without fuel, enabling long-distance maneuvers powered by light.
picks.why_it_matters: Solar sails are the bridge between fantasy and physics — plausible pathway to missions measured in decades instead of years, toward the outer solar system.

picks.title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS OF SENSOR DATA FUSION
picks.plain_summary: Integration of signals from multiple sensors to create a unified real-time picture of activity in space.
picks.why_it_matters: Tracking and detection capability multiplies with sensor fusion — essential for debris avoidance, satellite servicing, and space situational awareness.

picks.title: SYSTEM FOR IN SITU RESOURCE UTILIZATION IN EXTRATERRESTRIAL ENVIRONMENTS
picks.plain_summary: Mining and processing equipment that extracts water and minerals from the Moon or other worlds for use by human crews.
picks.why_it_matters: In-situ resource utilization is the enabling layer for Moon bases and Mars settlements — the difference between visiting and staying.

picks.title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR COMBINED CONTROL MOMENT GYROSCOPE AND THRUSTER CONTROL
picks.plain_summary: A way to coordinate spinning gyroscopes and thrusters so spacecraft can point and maneuver more efficiently with less fuel.
picks.why_it_matters: Better attitude control means longer satellite lifespans, cheaper operations, and more precise mission capability — the unglamorous backbone of orbital infrastructure.
